sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||':'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, (pnl/quantity)*100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END AS entry FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)), b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN entry<=7 THEN '01_le7c' WHEN entry<=10 THEN '02_8-10c' WHEN entry<=15 THEN '03_11-15c' WHEN entry<=25 THEN '04_16-25c' ELSE '05_gt25c' END AS band, series, contest, c FROM t) SELECT band, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT series) AS series, count(DISTINCT contest) AS contests, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c>0),2) AS avg_win, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c<0),2) AS avg_loss, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c<0)/count(*),2) AS loss_pct, round(sum(c)/100.0,2) AS total_usd FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
